text.zh-CN:
冠心病是供应心肌的血管变窄或受阻，使心脏得不到足够血液。

- 活动时胸部压迫感称为心绞痛，也可表现为气短。
- 有些人平时症状很少，首次表现可能是心肌梗死。
text.en:
Coronary heart disease limits blood flow through arteries supplying the heart muscle.

- Exertional chest pressure is called angina; breathlessness can also occur.
- Some people have few symptoms before a heart attack.

text.zh-CN:
常见原因是血管壁逐渐积聚脂肪性斑块。

- 斑块破裂后形成血栓，可突然堵住血管。
- 吸烟、高血压、高胆固醇和糖尿病是可处理的风险。
- 年龄及早发心脏病家族史无法改变，但仍能降低其他风险。
text.en:
Fatty plaque commonly builds up in artery walls.

- Plaque rupture can trigger a clot and sudden blockage.
- Smoking, high blood pressure, cholesterol and diabetes are treatable risks.
- Age and family history cannot change, but other risks can still be reduced.

text.zh-CN:
新发或改变模式的胸痛要按可能的心脏急症处理。

- 持续胸部压迫、向手臂下颌背部放射，伴冷汗、恶心或气促：呼叫急救。
- 休息时也痛或原有心绞痛明显更频繁、更重，需紧急评估。
- 不要自己开车或等它自行消失。
text.en:
New or changed chest pain may be a cardiac emergency.

- Persistent pressure spreading to the arm, jaw or back with sweating, nausea or breathlessness requires emergency help.
- Pain at rest or increasingly frequent or severe angina needs urgent assessment.
- Do not drive yourself or wait for it to pass.

text.zh-CN:
稳定症状也需要明确诊断和长期管理。

- 反复活动胸闷、休息后缓解应尽快预约评估。
- 已确诊者按个人胸痛行动计划处理；不按以往方式缓解应急求助。
- 复诊讨论活动耐受、药物副作用和风险指标。
text.en:
Stable symptoms still need diagnosis and ongoing care.

- Recurrent exertional discomfort relieved by rest warrants prompt assessment.
- Follow the prescribed chest-pain plan; seek urgent help if relief differs from usual.
- Reviews assess activity tolerance, adverse effects and risk measurements.

text.zh-CN:
医生根据症状和风险选择检查。

- 心电图记录电活动；急性胸痛可能需要反复心电图和心肌损伤血检。
- CT冠状动脉成像、负荷检查或造影回答不同的供血问题。
- 一次正常心电图不能单独排除所有冠心病或早期心梗。
text.en:
Tests are selected for symptoms and risk.

- ECG records electrical activity; acute pain may require repeat ECGs and blood tests for heart damage.
- CT coronary imaging, stress tests or angiography answer different blood-flow questions.
- One normal ECG cannot exclude all coronary disease or an early heart attack.

text.zh-CN:
不是所有胸痛都来自冠脉，但要先识别危险原因。

- 胃食管反流、胸壁肌肉痛和焦虑可有相似不适。
- 肺栓塞、主动脉问题或气胸也可能危及生命。
- 疼痛位置或服胃药后好转不能独自作出安全判断。
text.en:
Not all chest pain comes from coronary arteries, but dangerous causes come first.

- Reflux, chest-wall pain and anxiety can overlap.
- Pulmonary embolism, aortic disease and pneumothorax can also threaten life.
- Location or improvement after indigestion medicine alone does not establish safety.

text.zh-CN:
治疗兼顾今天的症状和今后的心梗风险。

- 戒烟、活动与饮食调整是长期基础。
- 药物缓解心绞痛并降低血栓和血脂相关风险。
- 部分人需支架或搭桥改善供血，但手术后仍需风险管理。
text.en:
Treatment addresses current symptoms and future heart-attack risk.

- Smoking cessation, activity and dietary changes support long-term care.
- Medicines relieve angina and reduce clot and cholesterol-related risk.
- Selected patients need stents or bypass surgery; risk management continues afterwards.

text.zh-CN:
不同药物用途不同，不能互相替代。

- 抗血小板药如阿司匹林降低血栓风险，也增加出血；不能自行开始或停用支架后的药。
- 他汀降低胆固醇，明显肌痛等需要告知医生。
- 硝酸酯缓解心绞痛，可头痛、低血压，不能与西地那非等勃起功能药合用。
text.en:
Medicines have distinct roles.

- Antiplatelets such as aspirin reduce clots but increase bleeding; do not independently start them or stop prescribed post-stent treatment.
- Statins lower cholesterol; report marked muscle pain.
- Nitrates relieve angina but may cause headache or low pressure and must not be combined with erectile-dysfunction drugs such as sildenafil.

text.zh-CN:
饮食帮助管理风险，不能立即打通堵塞的血管。

- 增加蔬菜、全谷、豆类和鱼，用不饱和脂肪替代较多黄油及肥肉。
- 减少高盐加工食品，有助控制血压。
- 没有一种保健品可替代处方治疗；合并心衰、肾病者需另定盐水要求。
text.en:
Diet manages risk rather than immediately opening blocked arteries.

- Choose vegetables, whole grains, beans and fish; replace excess butter and fatty meats with unsaturated fats.
- Reduce salty processed foods to support blood pressure.
- Supplements do not replace treatment; heart or kidney failure may require specific salt and fluid advice.

text.zh-CN:
日常安排要让活动和应急都可执行。

- 在医生或心脏康复指导下逐渐活动，胸痛时停止并按计划求助。
- 记录症状发生的活动、时长及药物反应。
- 规律服药和检查血压，随身保留药物清单及已处方的缓解药。
text.en:
Make activity and emergency planning practical.

- Build activity with clinical or rehabilitation guidance; stop for chest pain and follow the action plan.
- Record triggers, duration and treatment response.
- Take prescribed medicines, monitor pressure as advised and keep a medication list and prescribed reliever available.

text.zh-CN:
表现和用药风险因人不同。

- 女性、老人及糖尿病患者可能以气短、恶心或疲乏为主，胸痛不典型也不能忽视。
- 肾病者检查和药物选择需要顾及肾功能。
- 孕期胸痛仍须排查急症，不能因年轻就排除。
text.en:
Presentation and medicine risks vary.

- Women, older adults and people with diabetes may have prominent breathlessness, nausea or fatigue; less typical pain still matters.
- Kidney disease affects testing and drug selection.
- Pregnancy-related chest pain still needs emergency assessment when indicated, regardless of young age.

text.zh-CN:
冠心病通常需要长期管理。

- 控制风险能减少事件，但症状消失不等于斑块完全消失。
- 随访检查血压、血脂、症状及出血或药物不耐受。
- 住院或支架后参加适合的心脏康复，并明确复诊和抗血小板疗程。
text.en:
Coronary disease generally requires long-term management.

- Risk control reduces events; symptom relief does not mean all plaque has gone.
- Reviews assess pressure, lipids, symptoms, bleeding and drug tolerance.
- After admission or stenting, use appropriate cardiac rehabilitation and clarify follow-up and antiplatelet duration.

text.zh-CN:
供血受限可造成不同程度损伤。

- 突然堵塞可引起心肌梗死，即部分心肌受损或死亡。
- 长期损伤可削弱泵血功能，形成心力衰竭。
- 严重心律失常可导致心脏骤停。
text.en:
Restricted blood flow can cause several complications.

- Sudden blockage may cause a heart attack, damaging or killing heart muscle.
- Long-term damage may weaken pumping and cause heart failure.
- Severe rhythm disturbances may cause cardiac arrest.

text.zh-CN:
预防首次事件和再次事件都要控制已知风险。

- 停止吸烟，逐步规律活动并维持适合体重。
- 检查并治疗高血压、高血脂和糖尿病。
- 已有冠心病者继续处方治疗，不能用没有症状作为停药理由。
text.en:
Preventing first and repeat events involves the same major risks.

- Stop smoking, build regular activity and maintain an appropriate weight.
- Detect and treat high pressure, cholesterol and diabetes.
- Continue prescribed secondary prevention even without symptoms.
